notes.title: Update - Bugs Fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is to inform you that a new build has been uploaded which fixed some bugs in the game.

Here is the overview of what's fixed:
- Player collisions with moving crate box and a few furniture were not triggering game over screen. It is now fixed and should work as intended.
- A few collision issues fixed and a few minor improvements made.

Thank you for your patience.

Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
